notes.title: Critical Update to version 0.1.4.a
notes.content:
Hi All,

A HUGE thank you to MANTRONIX for reporting a critical bug that crept into the latest build!

There was a small, but critical bug that prevented the guns from firing on the instructions menu. This prevented anyone from being able to play the game.

I've just uploaded a new build (v 0.1.4.a), which appears to have fixed the problem on my side.

Please do let me know if any of you are having any issues. Feel free to drop me a mail, so I can be alerted to any issues that arise and fix them ASAP!

Mail me directly at : info@appsbybrats.com

Cheers!

notes.title: Update v0.1.4 ADDS OCULUS RIFT SUPPORT!
notes.content:
Hi all, sorry for the delay since the last update. We've been working hard to support the Oculus Rift, and have made a few tweaks and bug fixes along the way.

So what's new?

- Oculus Rift is now officially supported! Haptic feedback has not yet been implemented, but we'll look at that for a future update.
- Increased the default reload speed of the Rail Gun.
- Increased the default reload speed of the Rocket Launcher.
- The "Energy" bar for each weapon has moved to appear jusr above the hand. Some gamers reported they were unaware of the reload bar in its previous location. (Please let me know if you like it where it is now)
- When power-ups are collected, the slow-mo effect is now a bit faster and the powerup title is now displayed for only half the time.
- Removed the delay between the Helicopters' sub-waves. Helicopters keep coming until the wave ends.
- Removed the delay between the Bombers' sub-waves. Bombers keep coming until the wave ends.
- Bombers have more health.
- Bombers drop more bombs depending on the difficulty level.
- The Red Skull intro has been sped up.
- Fixed a few bugs that caused various issues.

Please let me know if you find any issues with the game, or have any suggestions to make it better :)

Cheers,
Brent

notes.title: Update v0.1.3a has just been released!!
notes.content:
Firstly, a huge thankyou to Rrajicard funding some bugs. They are now squashed! :)

- Fixed "Game Menu" bug, where weapons could be displayed again after you die and hide the game menu.
- The dreaded Star wave:  Adjusted the number of the stars to 10. Also fixed a bug where stars would keep popping out indefinitely.
- UPGRADE screen: It is now easier to see how many tokens you have left.
- The VR Keyboard has been fixed. It would sometimes cause a weird flipping effect, depending on where you're standing.

Please report all bugs, so I can handle them ASAP!

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update v0.1.2a - Improved Game Difficulty Balance
notes.content:
In a continued effort to ensure the game is properly balanced, this minor update corrects the following:

- Wave 6: Those infamous bombs have been adjusted. There are now fewer bombs and they are spaced further apart. This wave is also moved become wave 9 now.
- Earn tokens FASTER! Now earn tokens for every 3 500 points, instead off every 10 000 points.
- The High Score Board has been adjusted with some lower scores, to make it easier to get onto the board. (Applicable to new installations of the game).
- All enemy bullets are a bit slower, to give time to dodge them.
- The "Flower Bot" wave (Pink and blue flowers), are now in front of you, instead of being 360 degrees around you.

Thank you for sending me your feedback to help make RetroGunX even better!

Please let me know if your think of any further balancing issues that should be addressed, or if you think of anything that could improve the gameplay for all :)

Cheers,
Brent

notes.title: Update v0.1.2 has just been released!!
notes.content:
Firstly, a BIG thank you to Bluetac for bringing a serious bug on wave 6 to our attention! The bug made it practically impossible to pass this wave, but it has now been fixed!

Release Notes:
- Fixed Wave 6 difficulty bug. (Frequency of bomb drops has changed, as well as health of bombs).
- You can now earn tokens depending on your score.
- The "UPGRADE" section is now opened on the main menu. (Upgrade and buy new weapons here).
- All weapons can be upgraded to level 10.
- The Machine Gun and Rocket Launcher are now locked by default.
- Code has been optimized.
- The High Score Board is now populated with default names and scores, so it doesn't feel empty. (You will have to clear your game cache to see these pre-populated scores)

Happy gunning :)
